name: twitter
description: Twitter/X posting and analytics: tweets, threads, engagement metrics

auth.label: X (Twitter) OAuth
auth.hint: Create an OAuth 2.0 app at developer.twitter.com; scopes cover tweet read/write, users.read, and offline.access.

marketplace.tagline: Post to X (Twitter) and track engagement from agent workflows — tweets, threads, and analytics on a schedule.
useCases: Draft and post tweets on a schedule
Post a thread from long-form content
Reply or quote-tweet from a queue
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Post, delete, and read analytics for tweets via X OAuth. Posting and deleting are public, mutating actions; deletes are irreversible.
